_comment: CE-4142 G1 - the Add Entity gallery's groups, in sidebar order. A side-bearing type lands in the group of the MOST SPECIFIC mask that matches its DIS type (a tie: the group listed first); a map graphic lands in the group whose tools list its placement tool; anything else is 'Other'. a group with "macros": true lists the macro FILES (CE-4210 MA-7), not TKB types. 'chips' names the level below the group that becomes the chip row: next (default: the first named DIS level below the mask) | kind | domain | category | none.
